title: ALPS-ADR Mapping
description: Maps ALPS Section 7 features to ADRs and the code paths they govern. Read by alps-writer plugin hooks to detect ADR drift.

alpsDocument.description: Path to the ALPS .alps.xml file relative to the repo root.

categories.description: Map of category id (kebab-case) to mapping entry. Category id matches the ADR directory path under docs/adr/ — a single segment for top-level categories (e.g., 'auth') or a slash-separated path of at most two segments for sub-vertical-slice folders (e.g., 'auth/login'). See README 'Category id format'.

feature.description: Human-readable feature name from ALPS Section 7.

alpsFeatureId.description: Stable id of the feature in the ALPS document (e.g., F-AUTH-01).

alpsRevision.description: Snapshot of the ALPS Section 7 feature this category's ADRs were last derived from — a short content digest or one-line summary written by feature-to-adr at conversion time. On re-run, feature-to-adr compares the current feature against this value to detect that the PRD moved ahead of the ADRs (PRD → ADR propagation). Opaque to hooks; compared only by the cycle skills.

syncStatus.description: Propagation state of this category relative to its ALPS feature. 'synced' = ADRs reflect the current feature. 'pending-review' = the PRD feature changed since alpsRevision and the ADRs have not yet caught up; set by feature-to-adr (update mode) / adr-sync, cleared once the ADRs are re-reconciled. Absent is treated as 'synced'.

codePaths.description: Glob patterns identifying source files governed by this category's ADRs.

adrs.description: Paths to ADR markdown files (relative to repo root).

dependsOn.description: Category ids this category depends on (prerequisites). Sourced from the ALPS Section 6.3 Feature Dependency Diagram by feature-to-adr, edge 'this --depends on--> X' becomes X in this list. Read by adr-impl to implement prerequisite ADRs first. Must reference existing category keys; keep acyclic.

tableDocs.description: Paths to schema/table documents (e.g., docs/tables/*.md, prisma/schema.prisma) that must stay bidirectionally linked with ADRs in this category. Used by the authoring-rules DB schema co-change rule and by adr-sync auxiliary doc check.
